releaseNotes: Simpler Home header and compact collections; cleaner Search with vertical recent searches; clearer five-tab navigation. MindRadio, Pure Song, Smart Experience, personalization, accounts, crossfade, offline music and playlists remain accessible.
limitations: Physical-phone upgrade, audio, Bluetooth and background playback acceptance testing remains required.
The built-in updater checks the stable feed; install this tester build using its download page.
